meta.title: The Whispering Vault
meta.premise: The abbey of Saint Corvin was abandoned in a single night. Kael has come for the sealed vault beneath it, and the abbot's study is the only room still lit.

study.name: the abbot's study
study.brief: A cramped room of ledgers and cold candle stubs; a loose flagstone hides something under the desk.

cloister.name: the cloister
cloister.brief: A frost-rimed colonnade around a dead garden; Brother Tomas sweeps it to no purpose.

bell-tower.name: the bell tower
bell-tower.brief: A cramped climb of rotten ladders above the nave, its bell long since stilled.

vault.name: the sealed vault
vault.brief: The undercroft chamber Kael came for, its door bearing a seal nobody living can read.
vault.description: The door is stone, and the seal cut into it is unweathered where everything around it has worn.
vault.when_reached: Kael has found the vault door: advance thread vault-seal with a note that the vault door is found. The seal is the whole obstacle now — press on what opening it will cost.

mara.name: Mara
mara.brief: The abbey's last scribe, cautious and tired, still cataloguing books nobody will read.

tomas.name: Brother Tomas
tomas.brief: A deaf old porter who sweeps the cloister and knows almost nothing about the vault.

elena.name: Elena
elena.brief: The vault's former archivist, hiding in the bell tower; she alone remembers the sealing rite; she catalogued the vault ledgers beside Mara for two winters, until the night she went below alone and never came back up.
elena.description: She carries the sealing rite in her head and nowhere else.
elena.when_reached: Kael has found the archivist: advance thread vault-seal with a note that the archivist is found. She will name a price before she gives the rite up, and the rite is not known until she has.

cloister-rat.name: a bloated rat
cloister-rat.brief: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not run from a lantern.

vault-map.name: the vault map
vault-map.brief: A creased chart of the undercroft, marking a stair the abbey's own plans deny.
vault-map.description: Drawn in an old hand; the undercroft it maps is larger than the abbey standing over it.
vault-map.when_reached: Kael has the stair charted: advance thread vault-seal with a note that the stair down is charted. The chart marks a way down from the cloister that the abbey's own plans deny — press on getting down there.

vault-seal.title: The sealed vault
vault-seal.note: Kael came for the vault under the abbey: the way down to it, the seal on its door, and what opening that seal costs.
